entries.snippet:
Anthropic has announced a new feature for its AI assistant Claude called "Skills," aimed at making Claude more useful for professional tasks. Skills are essentially folders containing custom instructions, scripts, and resources that enhance Claude's performance in specific work contexts, such as Excel tasks or adhering to brand guidelines. These Skills can be created and deployed across Claude.ai, Claude Code, Anthropic’s API, and the Claude Agent SDK, allowing organizations to tailor the AI to their workflows. Early adopters include Box, Rakuten, and Canva.

This move reflects a broader industry goal among AI leaders like Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and Microsoft to transition AI agents from conceptual tools into truly practical, context-aware aides. Brad Abrams of Anthropic noted that the focus is on enabling Claude to perform tasks effectively within each organization’s unique context rather than achieving generic benchmarks. Anthropic’s announcement follows similar developments by OpenAI, which recently introduced AgentKit at its DevDay event. The tool helps developers and companies move from AI prototypes to production-ready agents, with use cases including retailers like Albertsons and platforms like Evernote and Canva.

The Skills feature is currently available to Claude Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise users.

parts:
我的建议：**不要为了“配套 skill”强行新建仓库**。你这个“期末试题生成”明显和现有 `exam-review-page` 是同一套学习/复习工作流，先放在同一个仓库更合理。

Claude Code 识别 skill 主要看**文件结构**，不是看 GitHub README 里有没有外链。Claude Code 的项目级 skill 路径是：

```text
.claude/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md
```

官方文档也说明，Claude Code 会自动发现项目里的 `.claude/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md`，并且 skill 的命令名通常来自 skill 目录名，比如 `.claude/skills/final-exam-generator/SKILL.md` 对应 `/final-exam-generator`。citeturn269000view0

你现在仓库 README 里已经写了 `exam-review` skill 的说明，但我在仓库文件列表里没看到实际的 `.claude/skills/exam-review/SKILL.md` 结构，只看到 README、`generate_review_page.py`、笔记和 HTML/PDF 示例等文件。citeturn303670view0 所以如果你想让别人真的安装/使用 skill，**README 说明不够，最好把 skill 文件夹也放进去**。

我会这样组织：

```text
exam-review-page/
├── README.md
├── generate_review_page.py
├── examples/
│   └── ...
├── .claude/
│   └── skills/
│       ├── exam-review/
│       │   └── SKILL.md
│       └── final-exam-generator/
│           └── SKILL.md
```

README 里再加一段：

```md
## Claude Code Skills

本仓库包含两个配套 Claude Code skills：

- `/exam-review`：根据教材 PDF 生成交互式复习页面
- `/final-exam-generator`：根据教材、考点笔记、考试范围生成期末模拟题/练习卷

使用方式：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/CRF2004/exam-review-page
cd exam-review-page
claude
```

然后在 Claude Code 中运行：

```text
/exam-review ./教材目录
/final-exam-generator ./教材目录 --based-on 复习笔记_考点版.md
```
```

什么时候才该新建仓库？

**适合放同一个仓库：**

你的“期末试题生成”依赖现有的考点笔记格式、PDF 页码引用、`复习笔记_考点版.md`、甚至未来还想把生成的试题嵌入复习页面。这个就是配套模块，放一起最好。

**适合新建仓库：**

如果你想把它做成一个完全独立的 skill，比如任何课程 PDF 都能生成试卷，不依赖 `exam-review-page`，也不关心你现有 HTML 复习页面，那可以新建：

```text
exam-question-generator-skill/
├── README.md
└── final-exam-generator/
    └── SKILL.md
```

但对你现在这个项目，我建议先别拆。**一个仓库里放两个 skill，README 里互相说明关系，是最清晰、维护成本最低的做法。**

你可以把定位写成：

> `exam-review` 负责把资料整理成考点复习页面；  
> `final-exam-generator` 负责基于这些考点生成模拟卷、答案、评分标准和错题回练。

这样比两个仓库互相外链更像一个完整产品。
